target: 565 Possibile Inventionem

source: 565 Possible Breakthrough
target: 565 Possibile Inventionem

source: Franca’s emotions were stirred by Lumian’s words, and she responded with anticipation, “Then it’s akin to catching a fox by its tail.
target: Motus Francae ex verbis Luminiani excitatus est, et cum exspectatione respondit: “Tum simile est vulpem cauda sua capere.

source: When the time comes, we’ll summon good helpers and strive to eliminate a few more key members of April Fool’s!
target: Quando tempus venerit, auxilia bona convocabimus et conabimur aliquos clavos partis Aprilis Stulti tollere!

source: As she spoke, she gritted her teeth.
target: Dum loquebatur, dentes strinxit.

source: Despite Lumian and Franca making various guesses and deductions about Ultraman’s role in last year’s prank, none of them felt they had grasped the key to the mystery.
target: Quamquam Lumianus et Franca varias coniecturas atque deductiones de parte Ultramanis in ioco anni praeteriti fecerunt, nemo sentit se arcanum verum comprehendisse.

source: Franca exhaled and said, “Phew, there are still some important puzzle pieces missing.
target: Franca suspiravit et dixit: “Hei, adhuc quaedam momenta puzzle magni momenti deficiunt.

source: See if you can fish out more details.”
target: Vide utrum plura indicia deprehendere possis.

source: She needed to return to Trier.
target: Eam ad Trier redire oportuit.

source: Lumian tersely acknowledged her words and asked thoughtfully, “How’s your search for the Tamara family’s descendant going?”
target: Lumian verbis eius breviter assensit et quaesivit, “Quomodo procedit investigatio tui descendentis familiae Tamarae?”

source: “Nothing yet, but Madam Judgment intends to inform the other Major Arcana card holders about this.
target: “Nihil adhuc, sed Domina Iudicium reliquos possessoros cartarum Maior Arcana certiorem facere intendit.

source: She hopes they can help keep an eye out,” Franca briefly explained her situation.
target: Sperat etiam eos vigilem fore,” Franca brevi ratione condicionem suam exposuit.

source: Lumian gazed at her face and said, “I have an investigative direction.”
target: Lumian vultum eius intuens dixit: “Rerum inquisitioni viam habeo.”

source: “What?” Franca perked up.
target: “Quid?” Franca subito excitata exclamat.

source: Lumian’s lips curled up.
target: Labra Luminiani convoluta erant.

source: “Investigate the other members of the Demoness Sect in Trier.
target: “Investiga reliquos Sectae Daemonissae membros in Trier.

source: Given the close ties between certain members of the Tamara family and the Demoness Sect, they might even be collaborating to establish the secret organization, Theosophy Order.
target: Propter nexūs arctos inter nonnullos ex familia Tamara et Sectae Daemonissae, fortasse etiam cooperantur ut condatur societas secreta, Ordo Theosophiae.

source: There’s a chance that one of them could directly join the Demoness Sect.
target: Exsistit casus, ut unus eorum directe Sectae Daemonissae se iungat.

source: Moreover, considering Madam Judgment’s mission for you to infiltrate the Demoness Sect, discern the Primordial Demoness’s current state and issues, why not investigate other Demonesses?
target: Praeterea, habita missione Dominae Iudicii ut in Sectae Daemonissae insinuaris et statum atque quaestiones Daemonissae Primordialis perscrutaris, cur alias Daemonissas non investiges?

source: Are you going to wait until you reach the level of a powerhouse like a Demoness of Red before gathering information?
target: Exspectabisne, donec attingas statum potentiae, sicut Daemonissa Rubra, antequam informationes colligas?

source: Do you believe there will be enough Angel-level Hunter Beyonder characteristics to aid your return to your original gender at that point?
target: Credisne fore ut satis habebis notis angelicis Hunter Beyonder, quae ad auxilium reditus ad generis originem tuam conferant?

source: “Why the Demoness of Red?” Franca instinctively focused on this question.
target: “Cur Daemonissa Rubra?” Franca instinctu quaestioni huic intendit.

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian subridens est.

source: “Have you forgotten your nickname, Madame Red Boots?”
target: “Oblitus esne sobri nomine tuo, Domina Ruber Calceorum?”

source: Franca smiled awkwardly.
target: Franca, quidem moeva, risum oblata est.

source: “Isn’t that to create a persona with characteristics that can be easily changed when you’re on the run?
target: “Nonne id ad creandum identitatem pertinet, quarum notae facile mutari possunt cum in fugā sis?

source: It’s clearly different from the description on the wanted poster.
target: Manifestum est hanc rem ab descriptione in tabula quaesitionis esse diversa.

source: Ahem, isn’t it too dangerous to investigate other Demonesses under the watchful eyes of the Demoness of Black?”
target: Ehem, nonne nimis periculosum est alias Daemonissas sub oculis vigilantibus Daemonissae Nigrae explorare?”

source: Lumian raised his eyebrows and smiled meaningfully.
target: Lumian supercilia attollens et risu significante subridens respondit.

source: “Why are you investigating the Tamara family?”
target: “Cur familias Tamarae investigas?”

source: “Investigating Mirror People,” Franca replied subconsciously.
target: “Homines Specularum investigo,” Franca subconscie respondit.

source: Lumian asked again, “And who assigned you the Mirror People investigation?”
target: Lumian iterum quaesivit: “Et quis tibi mandavit ut Homines Specularum investigares?”

source: “The Demoness of Black…”
target: “Daemonissa Nigra…”

source: Franca immediately shut her mouth.
target: Franca statim os clauserunt.

source: She then muttered to herself, “However, an intricate balance needs to be struck.
target: Deinde sibi murmuravit: “Attamen, subtilis aequilibrium statuendum est.

source: The source of the intel must be fabricated nicely; otherwise, we’ll still be suspected.”
target: Fons notitiarum pulchre fingendus est; aliter denuo suspecti erimus.”

source: Lumian didn’t say anything else.
target: Lumian nihil amplius dixit.

source: He grabbed Franca’s shoulder and planned to send her back to Trier.
target: Ea Francae umerum arripuit et consilium cepit eam ad Trier remittere.

source: Franca glanced at the curtained window and eagerly said, “Remember to ask me for help when you visit the combat nuns in the future.”
target: Franca fenestram cortinata intuita, ardenter dixit: “Memento me rogere auxilium, cum futuras moniales pugnantis visitas.”

source: She arrived in Port Santa in the afternoon and spent a long time using the fake name—Charname—she chose herself, and the face on Lumian’s fake ID to travel about.
target: Postmeridie in Port Santa advenit atque diu sub nomine ficticio—Charname—quo ipsa delectata est, una cum imagine in ID ficta Luminiani, pererravit.

source: With her fluent Highlander, she quickly grasped the folklore and combat nuns’ styles.
target: Linguā Highlander fluente, celeriter fabulas populares et modos monialium pugnatorum percogit.

source: Lumian scoffed dismissively.
target: Lumian irrise despiciens exclamavit.

source: “Don’t even think about it. You can’t impregnate them.”
target: “Ne quidem cogita; has concipere non potes.”

source: Franca replied indignantly, “Theoretically, it’s not impossible, but it’s quite dangerous.
target: Franca indignanter respondit: “Theoretice, non est impossibile, sed certe periculosum est.

source: Think about it, Madame Pualis.”
target: Cogita de hoc, Domina Pualis.”

source: Lumian was left speechless.
target: Lumian sine verbis relicto est.

source: “Besides, giving birth isn’t the only important thing in life…”
target: “Praeterea, partus non solum res magni momenti in vita est…”

source: Franca continued to search for an excuse.
target: Franca ulterius excusationem quaerere continebat.

source: Lumian exhaled silently and activated the black mark on his right shoulder.
target: Lumian tacite suspiravit et signum nigrum in dextro umero suo activavit.

source: He disappeared from the master bedroom with Franca, who was still talking.
target: Ex conclavi principali cum Franca, quae adhuc loquebatur, evanuit.

source: In no time, Lumian reappeared at the exact spot he had left.
target: Mox in eodem loco, unde abiit, Lumian apparuit.

source: Shaking his head and teasing Franca, he eased back into the armchair.
target: Capite concussus et Francam ludens, in sella relaxavit.

source: It had to be acknowledged that bantering and joking with friends, free from the need for caution, proved helpful in relieving the pent-up emotions within him.
target: Agnoscendum est iocos ac ludos cum amicis, sine sollicitudine, adiuvare ad levandas animorum cogitationes repressas.

source: Having regained his composure, Lumian reclined in his chair, sorting through the information on the sea prayer ritual and various rhetoric in his mind.
target: Compositum repetens, Lumian in sella recubuit, percurrens notitias de ritu precationis maris et varias rhetoricas in mente sua.

source: He sought details that might unveil traces of Ultraman’s existence and confirm any overlooked issues.
target: Quaerebat indicia quae vestigia Ultramanis existentiae detegere et quaestiones neglectas confirmare possent.

source: As a Conspirer, Lumian didn’t require jotting down key points on paper.
target: Ut Coniurator, Lumian puncta clavis in charta scribere non necesse habebat.

source: He relied on his eyes to decipher the hints.
target: Oculis confidebat ut subtilia enodaret.

source: All the information formed a colossal spiderweb in his mind, slowly weaving and transforming.
target: Omnis informatio ingentem telam araneam in mente eius texit, lente intertexens et transformans.

source: After a while, he abruptly sat upright.
target: Post aliquod tempus repente rectus consedit.

source: A breakthrough had been unearthed that could expose the essence of the sea prayer ritual.
target: Inventum erat breakthrough, quod essentiam ritu precationis maris revelare posset.

source: Lumian stood and exited the master bedroom.
target: Lumian surrexit et ex conclavi principali egreditur.

source: He spotted Ludwig devouring a crispy potato omelet at the dining table in the living room.
target: Ludwigum conspexit, qui omeletam patatae crispam in mensa conviviali deglutiebat.

source: Seated across from the boy, Lumian smiled as he retrieved the mutated black spider’s compound eye, a spiritual ingredient lacking Beyonder characteristics.
target: Ad oppositum puero sedens, Lumian subridet, dum accipiebat oculum compositum ex aranea nigra mutato, ingredientem spiritualem carentem notis Beyonder.

source: Ludwig immediately glanced up at Lumian.
target: Ludwig statim ad Lumianum respexit.

source: “Can you eat this?” Lumian flicked the black compound eye.
target: “Potesne hoc edere?” Lumian oculum compositum nigrum distulit.

source: Ludwig vigorously nodded.
target: Ludwig vehementer annuit.

source: “Yes.”
target: “Ita.”

source: Intrigued, Lumian took out the Mystery Prying Glasses and inquired, “Can you eat this?”
target: Curiosus, Lumian Specula Mysterii exprompsit et quaesivit: “Potesne hoc edere?”

source: “Not yet,” Ludwig honestly replied.
target: “Nondum,” Ludwig sincero respondit.

source: Not yet.
target: Nondum.

source: In other words, perhaps in the future?
target: Aliter, fortasse in futurum?

source: Lumian stowed away the Mystery Prying Glasses and placed the mutated black spider’s compound eye on the dining table before him.
target: Lumian Specula Mysterii recondidit et oculum compositum ex aranea nigra mutato in mensa conviviali ante se posuit.

source: “I’d like you to translate something.
target: “Velim ut aliquid transferas.

source: If you can provide the correct answer, it’s yours for consumption.”
target: Si rectam responsionem praebere potes, tibi ad edendum tradetur.”

source: Ludwig gulped and agreed, “Okay.”
target: Ludwig voraciter edax annuit: “Bene.”

source: Lumian recalled Lato Guiaro’s strange pronunciation and emitted a chattering sound.
target: Lumian insolita pronuntiatiōnem Lato Guiaro meminit et sonum striduli edidit.

source: Finally, he said, “That’s the general idea.”
target: Denique dixit: “Id est sensus generalis.”

source: Ludwig shook his head in disappointment.
target: Ludwig caput demisit in maerore.

source: “I don’t know.”
target: “Nescio.”

source: He paused briefly before adding, “But I think I’ve heard it somewhere.
target: Brevi intervallo cessavit antequam addidit: “Sed puto me id alicubi audivisse.

source: It’s somewhat familiar.”
target: Aliquantopere nota est.”

source: Had most of his memories and knowledge been sealed when his Body of Heart and Mind was sealed?
target: Num pleraque memoriae eius atque scientia sigillata fuerunt, cum Corpus Cordis ac Mentis eius obstrictum est?

source: Under Ludwig’s reluctant gaze, Lumian returned the mutated black spider’s compound eye to his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Sub oculis reticentibus Ludovici, Lumian oculum compositum ex aranea nigra mutato in sacculus viatoris reddidit.

source: Ludwig shoved a mouthful of potato omelet into his mouth and mumbled, “If you can find a creature that understands this language for me to eat, I can translate for you.”
target: Ludwig osculum omeletam patatae in os suum impulerat et murmure dixit: “Si invenire potes creaturam quae hanc linguam intellegat, ut eam mihi edendum offeram, ego pro te transferam.”

source: Wh… Lumian asked in surprise, “Can you acquire a certain ability or knowledge by consuming something?”
target: “Heu…”, Lumian obstupefactus quaesivit: “Licetne tibi aliquam facultatem aut scientiam per aliquid consumendum adipisci?”

source: “There’s a time limit, and it depends on the specific situation,” Ludwig succinctly explained without elaborating.
target: “Tempus limitatum est, et ex singulari condicione dependet,” Ludwig breviter explicavit sine ampliori expositione.

source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
target: Lumian cogitabunde annuit.

source: “Were you able to reveal information about the Batings Black Insect because you had consumed that kind of insect shortly before?”
target: “Fuitne tibi revelare notitias de Insecto Nigro Batings quia illud insectum nuper consumpsisti?”

source: Ludwig nodded.
target: Ludwig annuit.

source: “Yes, it wanted to ambush me.
target: “Ita, me insidiari volebat.

source: It had been waiting for a long time.”
target: Diuturno tempore exspectaverat.”

source: That explains it.
target: Hoc explicat.

source: I had thought you had recovered some of your memories and knowledge.
target: Putabam te aliquas memorias atque scientiam revisam esse.

source: Indeed, a paralyzing attack wouldn’t only target Lugano.
target: Revera, impetus paralyticus non solum Lugano petiverit.

source: After all, this could turn into a trap at any moment…
target: Postremo, hoc omni momento in insidias verti potest…

source: Lumian stood up and left the dining table, returning to the master bedroom under Ludwig’s pitiful gaze.
target: Lumian surgens a mensa conviviali discessit, ad conclavi principali revertens sub oculis Ludovici miserandis.

source: He had no means to find Ludwig a creature that understood the Language of the Sea.
target: Non habebat viam ut Ludwig inveniret creaturam quae Linguam Maris intellegat.

source: The Fisheries Guild members couldn’t be certain if their interpretation was accurate.
target: Membra Guildae Piscariorum certi esse non poterant utrum interpretatio eorum recta esset.

source: After entering the master bedroom and closing the door, Lumian lowered his voice and said, “Temiboros, do you understand that language?
target: Postquam in conclavi principali ingressus et ostium clausit, Lumian vocem demisit et dixit: “Temiboros, hanc linguam intellegis?

source: Do you know the true meaning of that sentence?”
target: Scisne verum sensum illius sententiae?”

source: Termiboros’s majestic voice echoed in Lumian’s ears.
target: Vocis Termibori magnificae in aure Luminiani resonaverunt.

source: “In any case, it doesn’t mean ‘We espouse thee, O sea, as a sign of true and perpetual dominion.’”
target: “Quocumque modo, hoc non significat: ‘Te amplectimur, o mare, ut signum veri et perpetui imperii.’”

source: With that, Termiboros fell silent again, showing no intention of explaining the true meaning to Lumian.
target: Hoc facto, Termiboros iterum tacuit, nulam intentionem ostendens verum sensum Luminiano explanandi.

source: Dammit, might as well not answer!
target: Male, potius ne respondeas!

source: You confirmed my guess but didn’t unveil the true content!
target: Coniecturam meam confirmavisti, sed verum contentum non develavisti!

source: Heh heh, could it be that you’re just pretending to understand?
target: Heh heh, num simulas te intellegere?

source: Lumian cursed inwardly, feeling that Termiboros, the Angel of Inevitability, was becoming less direct and straightforward than before.
target: Lumian intus maledixit, sentiens Termiboros, Angelus Inevitabilitatis, minus directe atque perspicue fieri quam olim.

source: He didn’t comprehend the art of sophistry.
target: Artem sophisticam non intellexit.

source: Gradually, He learned how to infuriate!
target: Paulatim didicit quomodo ad irascendum pervenire!

source: Lumian composed himself and settled back into the armchair.
target: Lumian se composuit et in sellam iterum recubuit.

source: Unfolding the letter, he began writing to Madam Magician.
target: Epistulam explicans, scribere incepit ad Dominam Magicam.

source: Detailing his travels, he recounted what he had observed in Port Santa.
target: Iter suum enarrantem, narrare coepit quae in Port Santa observaverat.

source: Finally, he pieced together the pronunciation and wrote down the words to the unknown language.
target: Denique pronuntiatiōnem componens verba linguae ignotae conscripsit.

source: He gave the interpretation of what the Fisheries Guild believed: “We espouse thee, O sea, as a sign of true and perpetual dominion.”
target: Interpretationem dabat eorum, quas Gilda Piscariorum credebat: “Te amplectimur, o mare, ut signum veri et perpetui imperii.”

source: Then, he made a request: “Madam, have you encountered this language before?
target: Tum rogavit: “Domina, antehac hanc linguam invenistine?

source: Do you know its true meaning?”
target: Novistine verum eius sensum?”

source: After folding the letter, Lumian initiated a ritual and summoned the “doll” messenger.
target: Epistulam condensata, Lumian ritum inivit et “pupulam” nuntium convocavit.

source: The “doll” messenger, adorned in a light-gold dress, emerged from the candle’s flame and surveyed its surroundings.
target: Nuntius “pupula”, ornatus tunica aurea leviter fulgente, ex flamma candelae emersit et circumiectorum inspiciens.

source: In a menacing tone, it declared, “Don’t let that filthy child near me!”
target: Tono minatorio declaravit: “Noli illud spurcum puerum mihi appropinquare!”

source: “He’s dining outside.
target: “Foris cenat.

source: He won’t enter without my permission.”
target: Non intrabit nisi consensu meo.”

source: For some reason, Lumian sensed hidden fear in the “doll” messenger’s aggressive words.
target: Quacumque ratione, Lumian metu occulto in verbis aggressivis nuntii “pupulae” sensit.

source: The messenger nodded in satisfaction.
target: Nuntius ex laetitia annuit.

source: “Keep an eye on it! If it acts up, don’t feed it!”
target: “Observa illud! Si male agit, noli alere!”

source: Using it as a substitute name… Lumian smiled and said, “If I don’t feed him, something even more terrifying might happen.”
target: Hoc ut nomen substitutum utens… Lumian subridens dixit: “Si non alam ei, aliquid etiam terribile accidere potest.”

source: The messenger fell silent for a moment before saying, “Then feed it more!”
target: Nuntius paulisper tacuit antequam dixit: “Tum amplius alere!”

source: With that, the doll-like messenger swiftly withdrew the folded letter into the candle flame.
target: Hoc facto, nuntius similis pupula celeriter epistulam condensatam in flammam candelae retraxit.

source: Lumian concluded the ritual, extinguished the candle’s flame, and gazed at the master bedroom’s door.
target: Lumian ritum confecit, flammam candelae exstinxit, atque ostium conclavi principali contemplatus est.

source: He muttered to himself, “It’s indeed a dangerous sealed creature…”
target: Sibi susurravit: “Vere est creatura clausa periculosa…”

source: He then retrieved the golden pocket watch from Salle de Bal Brise and opened it to take a look.
target: Deinde horologium aureum e Salle de Bal Brise rapuit et aperuit ut intueretur.

source: Suddenly, he transformed into a shadow, seamlessly blending into the darkness.
target: Subito in umbram se convertere coepit, in tenebris perfecte miscendo.

source: There was still something to attend to tonight.
target: Hodie adhuc aliquid est quod curandum sit.

source: In the port district, atop the Fisheries Guild’s castle-like building, Lumian found Lato Guiaro waiting on the spot resembling a tower, dressed in a formal suit.
target: In regione portuaria, super aedificium simile castelli Guildae Piscariorum, Lumian invenit Lato Guiaro in loco, qui turri similis exspectabat, habitu formali indutus.

source: “Are you on duty tonight?” Lumian casually pressed down on his golden straw hat, as if engaging in casual conversation with a friend.
target: “Esne in officio hac nocte?” Lumian, fortuito pileum foliosum aureum deprimens, quasi amico colloquium levem habens, inquit.

source: Lato, the middle-aged man, sighed and said, “Originally, no, but since you wanted to come over, that’s the case.
target: Lato, vir mediātus aetatis, suspiravit et respondit: “Initio non, sed quoniam advenire voluisti, ita evenit.

source: We can’t let an old man like the president do it, right?”
target: Senem ut praesidem id peragere non sinere possumus, nonne?

source: Without further ado, Lumian conjured delayed crimson, nearly white fireballs and hurled them into various corners of the tower.
target: Nullo mora, Lumian globos ignis cremoreos paene albos, moram tenuem evocavit, et in variis angulis turris iactavit.

source: Having completed this task, he waved at Lato Guiaro and melted back into the shadows.
target: Hoc negotium perfecerit, Lato Guiaro salutavit et in umbras defluit.

source: Lato approached the tower’s entrance, clenching his fists in fear.
target: Lato ad introitum turris accessit, manus in metu contrahens.

source: In just 30 seconds, the crimson, nearly white fireballs exploded simultaneously.
target: In tantis triginta secundis, globi ignis cremorei paene albi simul erupti sunt.

source: Rumble!
target: Rugitus!

source: The entire tower became engulfed in flames, and Lato, stationed at the entrance, was sent flying by the shockwave.
target: Turris tota flammas voravit, et Lato, ad introitum stans, impetu undae in aethera proiectus est.

source: Bright scales had already surfaced on his body to mitigate the damage.
target: Splendida squama iam in corpore eius apparuerunt ut damna levarem.

source: Rumble!
target: Rugitus!

source: In less than half an hour, everyone in Port Santa who was well-informed learned something: the Fisheries Guild had been bombed!
target: Minus dimidius horae, omnes in Port Santa bene noti didicerunt: Gilda Piscariorum bombata fuit!
